[Max money (9,999,999)]
*Holds money at the game's own cap, 9,999,999 (Misc +8, SaveData +0x38E8).
*Rewritten about 5 times a second while you are in the field (FieldRo),
*so money never stays down. Never applied at boot (see notes).

B06DF084 00000000

B06A59C4 00000000

D2000000 00000000

[Max BP (9,999)]
*Holds Battle Points at the game's cap, 9,999 (Misc +0x120, SaveData +0x3A00).
*Applied only while in the field (FieldRo).

[Rare Candy x999 (needs one in the Bag)]
*Sets the Rare Candy slot of the Medicine pocket to 999.
*You need at least one Rare Candy already; it does not add the item.
*Clears that slot's NEW badge and Free Space mark. Field only.

[Infinite Poke Balls (x999)]
*Keeps every Poke Ball type you carry at 999 (all 27 ball items).
*Only ball kinds that have a Bag slot (count-0 slots too); it does not add
*new kinds. Applied in the field only: balls thrown in a battle come back
*when the battle ends.

[Always shiny (wild Pokemon)]
*Code patch at 0x320D08 in the Pokemon-creation code: the 'random, roll for
*shiny' PID mode always takes the forced-shiny branch.
*Turning it off does NOT undo the patch until the game restarts;
*use 'Always shiny: undo' (and turn this one off) to restore it live.
D3000000 00000000
00320D08 EA000016
D2000000 00000000

[Always shiny: undo (restore original code)]
*Writes the original instruction back at 0x320D08. Do not enable together
*with 'Always shiny'. Turn it off again once applied.
D3000000 00000000
00320D08 E5D40023
D2000000 00000000
